Write a model as SBML

Source: R/write.R
sbml_write.Rd

Writes an sbml_model as an SBML Level 3 Version 2 core document, whatever level and version it was read from. Attributes that are NA are left out; notes, annotation and constraint messages are written as they were read; math is written as MathML. Reading the result gives back an identical model for any Level 3 Version 2 input.

Usage

sbml_write(m, path = NULL)

Arguments

m

An sbml_model.

path

A file to write, or NULL to return the document as a string.

Value

The path, invisibly, or the document as a string when path is NULL.

Details

The document is written as text, escaping attribute values and names.

Errors

zusbml_write_error for math with no MathML equivalent, naming the R call, for text with characters XML 1.0 does not allow, for notes, annotation or messages that are not well-formed XML, and for a fast reaction, which Level 3 Version 2 cannot express. zusbml_arg_error when m is not a model or path is neither NULL nor a single string.

Examples

m <- sbml_read(system.file("extdata", "decay.xml", package = "zusbml"))
path <- tempfile(fileext = ".xml")
sbml_write(m, path)
identical(sbml_read(path), m)
#> [1] TRUE
